installed_awk_help:
awk [-F separator] [-v name=value] [-f programfile] [program] [file ...]
One True Awk: process records using patterns, actions, arrays/functions.
-F sets FS; -v assigns before BEGIN; repeat -f to combine program files.
Without -f, first operand is the program. Files default to stdin; - is
stdin. name=value file operands assign variables at that input position.
-- ends options; --csv reads CSV records (do not also set FS).
-safe disables file output and unsafe features; -d[N] enables debugging.
-version/--version prints the upstream version. No GNU option parity.
Exported variables appear in ENVIRON; private shell variables do not.
Records, fields and arrays grow with application memory; call depth 64.
No system(), command pipes or child processes. File I/O uses data forks.
Example: awk -F: '{print $1}' file
